We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Designer (Static Ads) (m/f/d) Your role

You translate concepts into static ads that stop the scroll and convert. You live in Figma, produce many variants fast, and measure yourself on performance, not aesthetics alone. You work closely with the Creative Strategist (who delivers the angles) and the Creative Director (who signs off).

What to expect

 * You design static ads for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels

 * You produce many variants fast for A/B tests and iteration

 * You turn the Creative Strategist's ad angles into strong visuals

 * You think in stop-scroll, hierarchy, and conversion - not just beautiful design

 * You work data-driven and optimize based on performance

Who we're looking for

 * Demonstrable experience designing high-performing static ads (portfolio required)

 * Figma pro, fast and iterative

 * You understand paid performance and think in CTR/conversion, not just aesthetics

 * Startup pace doesn't scare you - the opposite

 * German + good English

What we offer

 * Competitive salary: €65,000-€90,000

 * Equity - you're building this, so you should own a piece of it.

 * Food & drinks - lunch and dinner are on us at the Vienna office (plus all the drinks you want, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).

 * Relocation bonus (if you still need to move to Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy.

 * Regular team offsites.

Hiring process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 20 min culture fit with the founders

1 Lead Advisor/AI-Native Engineering Your Tasks
 * Introduce AI-assisted engineering into client teams and make it stick - coding assistants, agents, spec-driven development.
 * Design guardrails for coding agents: scoped permissions, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, review and CI gates that agent-generated code can't bypass.
 * Keep quality high where agents are in the loop - definition of done for agent output, tests and static analysis as the real safety net, review practices that catch plausible-but-wrong code.
 * Run agents economically - right-sized context and models per task, no runaway loops, cost tracked per outcome.
 * Assess AI readiness at delivery level and map legacy systems onto realistic replacement paths.
 * Independently facilitate Big Picture Event Storming and technical workshops with CTOs, architects, and development teams.
 * Help evolve SQUER's "AI in the SDLC" offering and spot follow-up engagement potential in running projects.

Your Qualifications
 * Several years of development experience, including a lead or senior role with real ownership of a system or a team.
 * AI-assisted coding on a complex project, professional or private - describable with tool, scope, and outcome.
 * Own AI practice beyond ChatGPT: own workflows, agents, MCP servers, custom GPTs.
 * Solid understanding of LLMs, agents, and RAG - what each is and when to use it.
 * Hands-on experience putting guardrails around coding agents, and a clear sense of where agentic coding typically goes wrong.
 * Confident in CI/CD, testing, and iterative delivery.
 * Comfortable running a workshop in front of an unfamiliar group.
 * Fluent in German and English - both required.

Your Benefits
Why You'll Love Working at SQUER:

 * Ownership & Responsibility: at SQUER, we believe in empowering our team. In our flat hierarchies, your ideas and actions matter more than titles. Take the reins, make an impact and grow with us.
 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Exciting Challenges & Real Impact: Dive into diverse projects where your work truly makes a difference - for our clients and for SQUER.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration and leverage our suite of AI tools and licenses (Anthropic, OpenAI, and more) to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * Be Part of a Thriving Team Culture: At SQUER, collaboration and connection are at the heart of what we do. Through open communication, shared successes, and meaningful team events - including our annual SQUER offsite - we cultivate a culture where everyone feels valued and inspired to grow together.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between 
€ 75.000 and € 95.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.

Apply now:

jobs.description: 1 Junior Scientists (f/m/d) for 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) - JOB ID: 269373  * You will develop and validate numerical signal processing algorithms for mobile 5G/6G ISAC scenarios using simulations and measurements from an SDR testbed combining RF, fiber optic, and quantum sensing. * Depending on your background, you will conduct algorithm research and contribute to real-time experiments using SDR hardware and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS). * Together with experienced colleagues, you will engage in establishing a unique 6G distributed MIMO sensing testbed based on SDR technology using open-source tools such as GNU Radio, RFNoC and LabVIEW for real-time FPGA algorithm design operating from 0.4 - 20 GHz. * You will learn how to evaluate the results and prepare them for further studies. * You will publish your research results in international journals and present them at conferences. * You will accumulate experience in a research field, that has an enormous range of applications from construction, logistics, aviation and railways to agriculture, robotics and defense. * You will gain experience in a group of international scientists and build up your professional network within European wide research projects.Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: * Completed technical studies (at least MSc.) related to Telecommunications, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) multi-static MIMO UAV sensing, (ii) quantum sensing with NV centers and Rydberg cells, (iii) multimodal sensing with fiber optic and distributed RF sensors, or (iv) ISAC using reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) and two-way ranging. Candidates should indicate in their cover letter how their background and interests align with one of these profiles (i-iv) and provide evidence of relevant expertise. Applications not addressing this point may not be considered. * Hands-on experience in radio frequency (RF) lab experimentation and printed circuit board design for the profiles listed above. * Excellent knowledge in the field of signal processing, RF propagation modeling, AI/ML and numerical simulation software development (MATLAB or Python) * Sound knowledge of electromagnetic field simulation tools, antenna design, and real-time FPGA programming. * Interest in reading and writing scientific publications and enjoyment of solving application-oriented questions from industry * High level of commitment and ability to work in a team * German and English skills commensurate with the role What to expect:  * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 56.784,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. * Our employee benefits include meal allowances, healthcare benefits, pension support, family benefits, additional days off, vouchers, sports and cultural activities, and flexible working models including up to 50% home office.We also support conference participation, networking, and individual training and career development opportunities. We encourage our Junior Scientist (f/m/d) to pursue a doctoral degree at TU Wien. Through the AIT-PhD programme with renowned universities, you will have the opportunity to conduct your PhD thesis in collaboration with AIT experts and national and international research partners. At AIT, we foster an inclusive and family-friendly work environment that promotes equal opportunities and values diversity across all levels of the organisation. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants. Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity....
